legal.title: Before you start
legal.intro: TAMGA is an experimental Linux package conversion tool. Please read these few points.
legal.p1: Use at your own risk: a converted package may not work correctly or, in rare cases, may conflict with your system. Back up your important data before installing a converted package.
legal.p2: No warranty: TAMGA is provided “as is”, under its MIT license. The authors cannot be held liable for damage to your system, data or software.
legal.p3: Suggested dependencies are estimated matches, sometimes taken from public databases (distribution repositories, Repology): always check before installing.
legal.p4: It is your responsibility to make sure you are allowed to redistribute or modify a package you convert.
legal.p5: Linux, Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, Red Hat, Arch Linux, openSUSE and the other names mentioned belong to their respective owners. TAMGA is an independent project.
about.title: About
about.author: Created by
about.privacy_text: No personal data, no telemetry, no ads. For online lookups, only package names are sent to Repology.
about.credits: Rust, Tauri, and the free libraries tar, flate2, liblzma, zstd, bzip2, lz4_flex, goblin. Runes: Noto Sans Old Turkic font (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
err.title: Cannot continue
err.foreign_script: This .sh script was not created by TAMGA: there is no way to know where its files go.
err.source_rpm: This is a source package (.src.rpm): it contains code to compile, not a ready-to-install program.
err.appimage: AppImages are not supported: they already run on every distribution.
err.archive: .zip and .rar archives are not Linux packages: TAMGA does not know where to install their files.
err.unknown_format: Unrecognized format. TAMGA accepts .deb, .rpm, Arch packages, Slackware packages (.txz, .tgz…), tar archives, Stampede packages (.slp), Solaris packages (.pkg) and .sh files created by TAMGA.
err.empty_name: The package name cannot be empty.
warn.debconf: This package asks questions during installation (debconf): they will not be carried over.
warn.non_root_owner: Some files belong to a user other than root: this is preserved.
warn.arch_mismatch: The declared architecture does not match the programs inside.
warn.noarch_binaries: The package claims to be architecture-independent but contains compiled programs.
warn.ld_conf_added: The libraries are in an unusual folder for the target: TAMGA added an ld.so.conf.d file so they can be found.
warn.missing_deps: Some dependencies could not be translated.
warn.scripts_included: The original scripts are included: check that everything works after installation.
busy.runes: “tamga” and “türük” written in Old Turkic runes (Orkhon script)
target.tar: Tar archive, to extract at the root /
install.failed: Installation failed. See the log below.
deps.generic_note: This format does not declare dependencies: the list shows the libraries the programs need; install them yourself if they are missing.
err.install_not_here: This format cannot be installed directly on this system. Use the command shown on a compatible distribution.
err.no_pkexec: Cannot ask for the administrator password (pkexec is missing). Use the command shown in a terminal.
err.install_cancelled: Installation cancelled: the password was refused or the window was closed.
err.solaris_write: TAMGA can read Solaris packages but cannot create them.
err.slp_version: This Stampede package uses a format version that is too old.
warn.solaris: Solaris package: its programs will not run on Linux. Only scripts, documents and data are usable.
warn.solaris_multi: This file contains several Solaris packages: only the first one is converted.
warn.solaris_missing: Some files listed in the Solaris package could not be found: they were skipped.
warn.tar_no_meta: Archive without package information: the name and version come from the file name. Check them before converting.
warn.tar_relocated: This archive is not laid out like a Linux system: its contents will be installed in /opt/<name>, with shortcuts in /usr/bin.
warn.tar_no_uninstall: A tar archive is installed by extracting it at the root: it cannot be uninstalled automatically.
warn.tar_no_scripts: A tar archive cannot contain installation scripts: they were not carried over.
warn.slp_arch: Stampede does not know this architecture: the package is marked “all architectures”.
runes.title: Your words in runes
runes.help: Type one or more words, separated by commas. TAMGA writes them in Old Turkic runes (Orkhon script) following Turkish pronunciation. Sounds that did not exist in Old Turkic get the closest letter: f → p, v → b, h → k, c → ç, j → y.
runes.note: As in the Orkhon inscriptions, the vowels a and e are only written at the start and end of a word, and runes are read from right to left.
runes.saved: Your runes are saved: they will appear while TAMGA works.
runes.too_long: Too long: {max} runes at most ({n} now).
busy.runes_words: Your words in Old Turkic runes (Orkhon script): {words}
deps.bundle_keep: Bundle this library with the package
opt.bundle: Bundle missing libraries with the package
opt.bundle_hint: If a library does not exist on the target distribution, TAMGA takes it from the official repositories of the original distribution and stores it in /usr/lib/tamga/<package>.
warn.bundled_libs: Libraries missing on the target are bundled with the package, in /usr/lib/tamga. The package's programs use them automatically; the rest of the system is not changed.
warn.tar_ldconfig: After extracting, run “sudo ldconfig” so that the bundled libraries are found.
settings.title: Settings
settings.verbose_hint: Shows live in a terminal everything TAMGA does: files read, commands run, addresses contacted, decisions. The log is also saved to a file.
settings.custom_hint: {cmd} is replaced by the command to run. Example: my-terminal -e {cmd}
err.no_terminal: No terminal found. Choose “Other command…” and enter your terminal's command.
err.terminal_unknown: TAMGA does not know this terminal.
err.terminal_failed: The terminal could not be started. Check that it is installed, or choose another one.
dropzone.click_multi: or click to choose one or more files
folder.label: Build folder
opt.fixperms_hint: Tidies up who may read, change or run each file, like in an official package: everything belongs to the administrator (root), programs stay runnable, documents become plain readable files.
opt.bump_hint: The release number goes for example from 2 to 3: your system will see this package as an update of the old one and replace it.
opt.check_hint: TAMGA opens the package again to make sure it is complete, then has it reviewed by the distribution's official checker if installed (lintian, rpmlint or namcap).
edit.arch_hint: The type of processor the package can be installed on. Only change it if you know the programs are suitable: TAMGA warns you otherwise.
arch.aarch64: aarch64 — 64-bit ARM (Raspberry Pi 4 and 5, ARM servers)
arch.noarch: all — no compiled program (scripts, documents, themes…)
warn.arch_forced: Warning: the programs in this package are made for a different processor type than the one chosen. They will not work on that processor.
warn.fixperms_done: File permissions have been tidied up.
warn.folder_written: The build folder is ready. Edit package.info and the files/ folder as you like (LISEZMOI.txt explains everything), then drag the folder into TAMGA to build the package.
folder.hint: “Build folder”: instead of a finished package, you get a folder with all the files and an information sheet. Change whatever you like, then open the folder in TAMGA again to build the package.
folder.choose: Where should the build folder be created?
result.folder_next: To build the package afterwards (or simply drag the folder into TAMGA):
check.title: Package check
check.legend: E = serious error · W = warning (quality advice) · I = information
check.summary_ok: No serious problem: the package is ready.
check.summary_errors: {n} serious error(s): the package may fail to install or work badly. Open the details below.
check.summary_warnings: No serious error, {n} warning(s): these are quality tips; the package usually works anyway.
check.note_converted: Converted packages often get remarks like these (no manual page, no changelog, maintainer address…): this is normal and harmless.
check.reopened: TAMGA reopens the package without problems: {files} files, {name} {version} ({arch}).
check.wrong_format: The created file is not recognised as {format} (TAMGA sees: {found}).
check.reopen_failed: TAMGA cannot read the package back: {error}
check.tool_ok: {tool}, the official checker, found no problems.
check.tool_failed: {tool} could not run its check (the tool seems badly installed): {error}
batch.title: Several packages
batch.hint: All these files will be converted to the same format, into the destination folder. If one package fails, the others carry on.
err.same_format: This package is already in that format.
err.not_build_folder: This folder is not a TAMGA build folder: it must contain package.info and a files/ folder.
